proposals.admission: Separate READY bounded_experiment, completed same-worker source result + independent primary approval/result/caps and reviewed typed execution binding. No automatic refit/default/official submission.
proposals.changing_factor: Representation only, fixed original two grouped class cuts42/43 and unchanged protected SINGLE; no regression replay.
proposals.discard: Any failed/null cut, missed independent gate, nonpositive gain on either cut or resource/source/clock/cleanup uncertainty. No posthoc class weights, reseed or blend.
proposals.fit_count_basis: Two strong categorical-view controls upper bound6 learner fits each including nested stopping/refits, plus four single-head fits. Primary must verify this source-based count before admission.
proposals.mechanism: Nonlinear bounded RBF128 may separate attack classes missed by a linear head; compare against the unchanged strong two-view SINGLE and matched linear representation.
proposals.metrics: Independent MacroF1 on BOTH original class cuts, support>=100 max drop0.01 and positive ex-rarest gain. RBF-minus-linear separately from RBF-minus-SINGLE.
